description: This file contains a static factory class for creating a pre-configured bUnit TestContext for unit testing Blazor components in the BlazorAdmin project. It sets up dependency injection with mock services and test configurations.

classes.name: TestContextFactory
classes.description: A static class providing a method to create a configured TestContext for testing Blazor components.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new bUnit TestContext with mocked services and settings for unit testing.
